Release packaging validation (2026-10-22)

Build: build-release, MinGW Makefiles, GCC 14.1.0 UCRT64 x86-64,
Release flags -O3 -DNDEBUG. Original build/ remains Debug.
No source or CMake changes were required.

CTest: 12/12 passed; total 4.10 seconds.
Packaged --demo --smoke-test: exit 0, 19/19 assets loaded.
Packaged --seed 43 --smoke-test from unrelated TEMP working directory:
exit 0, 19/19 assets loaded. Both ran with PATH restricted to Windows directories.

Normal --demo launch: process remained alive and responsive after three seconds.
Desktop screenshot capture failed (invalid screen handle in execution environment),
so visual appearance was not manually verified. Hidden-window OpenGL smoke tests
successfully exercised rendering and resizing. See build-release logs for details.

PE imports inspected recursively using objdump -p. Bundled non-system dependencies:
libstdc++-6.dll, libgcc_s_seh-1.dll, libwinpthread-1.dll.
Remaining imports are Windows system / Universal CRT libraries.
GLFW, ImGui and GLAD are static; GPU OpenGL drivers and WIC are OS dependencies.

This is a single-host validation, not a clean-machine compatibility certification.
Full assets/ tree retained, including source atlas and provenance README.
